title: heelz!
bio: “heelz!” is the third song JinnaWoods recorded, originally meant for his scrapped debut *New York Slutz*. The demo leaked and was criticized for its rough vocals, but it was later expanded and re-produced by periyuh to appear on QueenServeantDonked’s second album *EMOtional SLAYage*. When the album’s original third track lost rights, this remix replaced it. It was featured again as track three on *The Iconic Pop*.
